entries.text: Rust: start with `cargo new name`, code in src/main.rs, dependencies in Cargo.toml, build with `cargo build --release`, run with `cargo run -- args`. Use `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt`.
Rust errors: return Result<T, E>, propagate with `?`, use anyhow for applications and thiserror for libraries. Avoid unwrap()/expect() outside tests and truly impossible cases.
Rust ownership: pass &T to read, &mut T to modify, T to transfer. Clone only when you need a second owner. Use String for owned text, &str for borrowed.
Rust data: struct + impl for types, enum with data for variants and match exhaustively; derive Debug, Clone, PartialEq as needed; Option<T> instead of null.
Rust collections and iterators: Vec, HashMap, HashSet; chain .iter().filter().map().collect::<Vec<_>>(); use .iter() to borrow, .into_iter() to consume.
Rust CLI: clap with derive (`#[derive(Parser)]`), serde + serde_json for JSON, reqwest (blocking or tokio) for HTTP, std::process::exit(1) on failure with a message on stderr.
Rust async: tokio runtime with `#[tokio::main]`, `async fn`, `.await`; use tokio::spawn for tasks and tokio::time::timeout to bound I/O.
Rust tests: `#[cfg(test)] mod tests { #[test] fn name() { assert_eq!(..) } }` in the same file, run with `cargo test`. Integration tests live in tests/.
